x.description: one-dimensional array of x-values for points to be binned.

y.description: one-dimensional array of y-values for points to be binned.

bins.description: Specify the number of bins in the histogram (default: 10). ``bins`` may also be an array specifying the locations of the bin edges, or a pair of integers or pair of arrays specifying the number of bins in each dimension.

range.description: Pair of arrays or lists of the form ``[[xmin, xmax], [ymin, ymax]]`` specifying the range of the data in each dimension. If not specified, the range is inferred from the data.

weights.description: An optional array specifying the weights of the data points. Should be the same shape as ``x`` and ``y``. If not specified, each data point is weighted equally.

density.description: If True, return the normalized histogram in units of counts per unit area. If False (default) return the (weighted) counts per bin.

output.description: A tuple of arrays ``(histogram, x_edges, y_edges)``, where ``histogram`` contains the aggregated data, and ``x_edges`` and ``y_edges`` specify the boundaries of the bins.
